svg.text: Episode 10 — one policy, five cars, envelope penalised
One network, told which car it is in. Framed on turn-in, the arc, and the first 30 m of exit.
Body = where the car points. Arrow = where it is going. Colour = how far apart those are (slip angle). Line colour = speed.
